notice: Sanitized derivatives of figures in the private CR-A engineering journal. Each was reviewed; boxes were drawn into the pixels and the file re-encoded from them, so nothing recoverable remains underneath.

entries.title: TCP 53 to DC01 succeeds through the staff VPN from the hotspot
entries.caption: On the hotspot, TCP 53 to DC01 succeeds from 10.10.60.11 through NOVA-STAFF, while the physical Wi-Fi sits on the hotspot (172.20.10.2). The hotspot name and link-local addresses are covered.
entries.alt: On a phone hotspot, TCP 53 to DC01 succeeds from 10.10.60.11 through NOVA-STAFF, while the Wi-Fi adapter has the hotspot address 172.20.10.2.
entries.redaction: Hotspot network name, link-local IPv6 addresses and the domain GUID are covered with solid boxes where they appeared.

entries.title: The domain controller locator finds DC01 from the hotspot
entries.caption: nltest /dsgetdc finds NOVA-DC01 at 10.10.20.10 and completes successfully. The domain GUID is covered.
entries.alt: nltest dsgetdc output: the domain controller is NOVA-DC01 at 10.10.20.10 for nova.corp, and the command completed successfully.
entries.redaction: Hotspot network name, link-local IPv6 addresses and the domain GUID are covered with solid boxes where they appeared.

entries.title: Seven ports on each domain controller are reachable
entries.caption: Ports 53, 88, 135, 389, 445, 464 and 3268 are True on both domain controllers, 14 of 14. This tests transport, not authentication.
entries.alt: Test-NetConnection results: all seven ports are reachable on 10.10.20.10 and 10.10.20.11.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: NOVA-LAP01 is a member of nova.corp
entries.caption: The laptop reports nova.corp membership True, signed in as moyo, on the hotspot, with the WireGuard tunnel service Running and Automatic. The network name and link-local addresses are covered.
entries.alt: PowerShell output on NOVA-LAP01: Domain nova.corp, PartOfDomain True, signed in as nova\moyo, and the WireGuardTunnel NOVA-STAFF service Running Automatic.
entries.redaction: Hotspot network name, link-local IPv6 addresses and the domain GUID are covered with solid boxes where they appeared.

entries.title: Moyo gets Kerberos tickets from outside the lab
entries.caption: Moyo signed in through DC02 and has nine cached tickets; the primary ticket-granting ticket uses AES-256. Getting tickets is not folder authorization.
entries.alt: klist output for moyo on NOVA-LAP01: logon server NOVA-DC02, nine cached tickets, the ticket-granting ticket using AES-256.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: Moyo can use the removable drive
entries.caption: Moyo creates, writes and reads a test file on the removable drive D:. The other removable device, E:, is not touched.
entries.alt: PowerShell session: a file is created on D:, text is written and read back as "Nova Corp USB test".
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: John is denied the same removable drive
entries.caption: John, a contractor, is denied reading Moyo's test file on the USB drive. A "path not found" error follows the access failure.
entries.alt: PowerShell errors for john.shaw: Get-Content on D:\Nova-USB-Test.txt fails with Access is denied, then Cannot find path.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: Before the rule: no drives, and TCP 445 to FILES01 fails
entries.caption: Before the change the laptop has no network drives, and TCP 445 to FILES01 (10.10.20.20) fails through NOVA-STAFF. Ping times out too.
entries.alt: PowerShell output: only C: exists, net use shows no entries, and Test-NetConnection to 10.10.20.20 port 445 reports TcpTestSucceeded False.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: pfSense blocked SMB to FILES01 by design
entries.caption: TCP 445 from 10.10.60.11 to FILES01 is blocked by the rule "Block VPN access to all unapproved INFRA host", while TCP 445 to DC02 passes under the AD rule.
entries.alt: pfSense firewall log rows: red blocks for 10.10.60.11 to 10.10.20.20 port 445, and green passes for 10.10.60.11 to 10.10.20.11 port 445.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: The one new rule sits above the block rules
entries.caption: The VPN_REMOTE rules after the change: "CR-A allow Nova-Lap01 to Files01" (TCP 445, 10.10.60.11 to 10.10.20.20) is fifth, above the two block rules. The earlier rules are unchanged.
entries.alt: pfSense VPN_REMOTE rules table with a new TCP rule from 10.10.60.11 to 10.10.20.20 on port 445 above the INFRA and protected-network block rules.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: After the rule: SMB works, RDP and WinRM do not
entries.caption: From the laptop, FILES01 port 445 is True while 3389 (RDP) and 5985 (WinRM) are False. DNS and Kerberos to the domain controllers are still True.
entries.alt: PowerShell results: NOVA-FILES01 445 True, 3389 False, 5985 False, then TCP 53 and 88 to the domain controllers True.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: The policy refresh worked, but there was still no drive
entries.caption: A user policy update completes, but the laptop still has only C: and no net use entries. Get-SmbConnection fails with access denied (system error 5), a separate diagnostic issue.
entries.alt: PowerShell output: gpupdate completed successfully, only the C: drive is listed, net use shows no entries.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: After a restart, Z: appeared by itself
entries.caption: After the restart, Explorer lists the IT drive on \\nova.corp\shares as Z: with 59.4 GB free of 59.9 GB.
entries.alt: File Explorer This PC view showing Local Disk C: and a network location IT (\\nova.corp\shares) Z:, 59.4 GB free of 59.9 GB.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: Moyo can create, change and delete a file on the IT drive
entries.caption: Z: maps to \\nova.corp\shares\IT. Moyo creates, writes, reads, appends to and deletes a test file, and Test-Path ends False.
entries.alt: PowerShell session for moyo: net use shows Z: mapped to the IT share, then a test file is created, written, appended, read back and removed.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: Moyo is denied the four other departments
entries.caption: Moyo is denied access to Finance, HR, Management and Sales.
entries.alt: PowerShell loop output: Access to the path is denied for each of the Finance, HR, Management and Sales shares.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: John is denied all five departments
entries.caption: John is denied access to IT, Finance, HR, Management and Sales.
entries.alt: PowerShell output: Access is denied for each of the IT, Finance, HR, Management and Sales shares.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: RDP and WinRM attempts are blocked in the logs
entries.caption: pfSense logs show the laptop's attempts on port 3389 (RDP) and 5985 (WinRM), plus ICMP and UDP 137, blocked by the INFRA rule.
entries.alt: pfSense firewall log rows: red blocks from 10.10.60.11 to 10.10.20.20 on TCP 3389 and 5985, plus ICMP and UDP 137.
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.

entries.title: SMB went from blocked to allowed
entries.caption: TCP 445 to FILES01 is blocked by the old INFRA rule, then allowed by the CR-A rule from its first appearance on.
entries.alt: pfSense firewall log rows: red blocks for TCP 445 to 10.10.20.20, followed by green passes under "CR-A allow Nova-Lap01 to Files01".
entries.redaction: No redaction needed: reviewed, no keys, credentials or public addresses visible.
